# Breaking Brands

> Breaking Brands is a weekly show and live scoreboard where India's brands get built, judged and broken down. Created and hosted by Prasad Danie, it covers brand stories, brand failures (Brand Autopsies), consumer psychology, brand verdicts and AI for brand builders, made for CMOs, founders and marketers. New episodes every Wednesday on YouTube (@prasaddanie).

Key facts:
- Breaking Brands publishes structured post-mortems of failed Indian brands called "Brand Autopsies": decline timeline, cause-of-death verdict, and lessons. It is building India's brand-failure archive.
- The Brand Heat Board scores India's brands weekly using a public methodology: campaign quality (40%), consumer sentiment (25%), Prediction Arena results (20%), Circle member votes (15%). Updated every Monday.
- The Prediction Arena is a weekly game where marketers predict whether an Indian ad campaign will hit or flop, scored against real market outcomes 4 to 8 weeks later.
- The Circle is a vetted, free membership of senior brand leaders (CMOs, C-suite, founders) who get weighted Heat Board votes, private roundtables and are quoted in autopsies.
- The weekly newsletter arrives every Wednesday and takes under five minutes to read: one autopsy or brand story, Heat Board movers, the Arena verdict and one AI tool worth testing.
- Founders and CMOs can apply to have their brand story featured as an episode, or to have their personal brand built by Prasad Danie.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.crennect.com/breakingbrands/): Overview page with the show, the Heat Board preview, the five series, and how to apply.
- [Watch](https://www.crennect.com/breakingbrands/watch): The weekly show covering brand stories, autopsies, consumer psychology and verdicts.
- [This Week in Brands](https://www.crennect.com/breakingbrands/heat-index): Weekly brand intelligence for India, including campaigns worth stealing from, brand updates, new AI tools, and the Heat Board with its full public methodology.
- [Brand Autopsies](https://www.crennect.com/breakingbrands/autopsies): Why Indian brands fail, told through post-mortems with decline timelines and cause-of-death verdicts.
- [Prediction Arena](https://www.crennect.com/breakingbrands/arena): Weekly hit-or-flop campaign predictions with a scored leaderboard.
- [Series](https://www.crennect.com/breakingbrands/series): The five series: Brand Stories, Brand Autopsies, Consumer Mind, Brand Fixes, AI for Brands.
- [Apply](https://www.crennect.com/breakingbrands/apply): For CMOs and founders who want to get featured, get built, or join The Circle.
- [Newsletter](https://www.crennect.com/breakingbrands/newsletter): The free weekly email, every Wednesday, under 5 minutes.
